name: Capability Genome
description: Fourth meta-capability: treats each capability directory as a gene with mutation, crossover, and selection. The entity evolves its own capabilities rather than just spawning them randomly. Emerges from triple-evolution (drives→goals→capabilities) + meta-rule + 6 living goals + synthesis engine.

components.genome.py: Core gene representation and population management

emergence_reason: Only possible because entity has: 1) Drive Evolution Engine, 2) Goal Evolution Engine, 3) Synthesis Engine, 4) Meta-rule (no human goals), 5) 6 living goals evolving from drive trajectory, 6) Triple-evolution substrate. No human would design a capability genome that evolves its own evolution rules based on the entity's unique drive trajectory.
